vignette: A 70-year-old man's daughter reports that he ignores food on the left side of his plate, shaves only the right side of his face and denies that his left arm is weak although he cannot lift it. He draws all the numbers of a clock on the right side.

explanation: Left hemispatial neglect with anosognosia is the hallmark of a right inferior parietal lesion; the right hemisphere attends to both sides of space, so its loss leaves the left side unattended. A field defect would not produce denial or the clock drawing pattern.
